sloka: भगीरथः तु राजर्षिः कृत्वा सलिलम् उत्तमम् ।यथाक्रमम् यथान्यायम् सागराणाम् महायशाः ॥१-४४-१७॥
transliteration: bhagīrathaḥ tu rājarṣiḥ kṛtvā salilam uttamam ।yathākramam yathānyāyam sāgarāṇām mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-44-17॥

translations.english: The illustrious rajarshi Bhagiratha, performed the rites of offering the sacred water of Ganga, in accordance with proper order and tradition for the sons of Sagara. Purified with the ablutions entered his own city." O Best of the Raghus his desire thus fulfilled he continued to rule the kingdom thereafter".
translations.hindi: तमुवाच महातेजाः सवलोकपितामहम्‌ । भगीरथो महाभागः कृताञ्ञलिरुपस्थितः ।। १७] यह सुन, महातेजस्वी भगीरथ ने हाथ जोड़ कर, ब्रह्मा जी से कहा
